narr: A push of monsoon moisture fueled an outbreak of thunderstorms across the Mojave Desert. Some storms produced severe weather and flash flooding.
ev: Minneola Rd and Yermo Rd west of Minneola were flooded. A railroad crossing signal was undermined by rushing water.
A vehicle was stuck in flood waters at the intersection of Jasper Rd and Cedar Rd.
lsr: TRAINED SPOTTER REPORTED FLOODING ON YERMO ROAD WEST OF MINNEOLA ROAD. THIS REPORT WAS LATER VERIFIED BY A VIDEO SHARED BY A MEMBER OF THE PUBLIC.
CHP REPORTS A VEHICLE STUCK IN FLOOD WATERS.
